title: Step 7 of step 9: a radial segment inside B_1(0) has positive H^1-measure
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, S ⊆ ℝ^P and z ∈ ℝ^P with z ≠ 0 and |z| < 1. Suppose t·z ∈ S for every real t with 0 < t ≤ 1. Then μH[1](S ∩ B_1(0)) > 0. Here μH[1] is Mathlib's 1-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P with the Euclidean metric, and B_1(0) is the open unit ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P), z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < 1 → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → t • z ∈ S) → 0 < μH[1] (S ∩ ball (0 : Euclid P) 1)
